response: Yes, symptoms can predict COPD in smokers. Chronic cough, sputum production, wheezing, and shortness of breath are common symptoms that may indicate the presence of COPD in smokers. However, not all smokers with these symptoms have COPD, and some people with COPD may not exhibit noticeable symptoms until the disease is advanced. A definitive diagnosis of COPD is typically made through spirometry, a lung function test that measures airflow obstruction.
